question: Can an unchanged statutory duty acquire a new subject-matter instance because an authority adds an identified member to an authentic dynamic set published outside EUR-Lex?

governing_rule.condition: article contains a substance meeting Article 57 criteria and identified in accordance with Article 59(1), above 0.1% w/w

set_definition.publication_rule: Article 59(10) requires ECHA to publish and update the candidate list on its website without delay after a decision on inclusion.
set_definition.authenticity_statement: ECHA states that only the Candidate List published on its website is deemed authentic.
set_definition.legal_consequence_statement: ECHA states that inclusion may create immediate legal obligations, including under Articles 7, 31 and 33.

membership_event.reason: Specific target organ toxicity after repeated exposure (Article 57(f) - human health)

derived_effect.bounded_statement: From inclusion onward, Article 33 duties can apply to suppliers of articles containing n-hexane above the statutory concentration threshold, subject to the rule's remaining conditions.

shared_shape: authoritative external set or status surface
membership/status transition changes the governing provision's output
derived local effect must not be represented as local textual mutation

important_difference.toy_case: Official Journal reference status is restricted for an already listed harmonised standard.
important_difference.reach_case: An agency adds a substance to an authentic Candidate List published on its own website.

forbidden_inferences: REACH Article 33 was amended on 4 February 2026.
n-hexane became a different chemical identity when added to the Candidate List.
All articles containing any n-hexane automatically breach Article 33 regardless of concentration and other statutory conditions.
The ECHA Candidate List is merely advisory metadata.
A Cellar Source Change record can honestly represent the ECHA website membership event by inventing Cellar identifiers.
A verified textual Mutation Candidate must be fabricated solely to satisfy Change Atom v0.3.
